notes.title: BlowHI Patch
notes.content:
Hello, this is Shooting RPG Blow High. 
It's been a while since I uploaded a patch. 

Patch contents
Character design change 
Added skill effects and changed implementation 
Stage difficulty classification 
UI convenience improvement 
Monster balance correction and added stage reward items 
Added auto-attack function
If you are confident in your control

Assassin, who dominates battles with a short attack range, but fast attack speed, movement ability, and excellent evasion skills

Knight, a solid defensive character who uses a shield to deflect monsters and bullets and hits multiple enemies with basic penetration effects

If you want strategic and powerful attacks

Archer, a long-range specialist who precisely suppresses enemies with long range and multi-hit skills

Mage, a master class who dominates the battlefield with powerful firepower and enemy-tracking magic

Please enjoy
